name.text: Q15. Tomorrow promotion comparison: seeded run

questiontext.text: In Predictive Analytics Experiment 5, use the original baseline data, refit a separate baseline-feature model on all 179 observed feature rows, and change CHOSEN_PROMO from 0 to 1. Hold tomorrow's date, weekday and latest observed demand fixed. What is the chosen forecast minus the no-promotion reference forecast?

generalfeedback.text: The forecast difference is +51.119570 units/day, equal to this fitted model's Promo coefficient. This is a model-based comparison with other inputs fixed. It does not prove real-world causal uplift, promotion profitability or an optimal replenishment quantity. The all-history operational refit is separate from holdout MAE evaluation.
